we.howto.title: How to get your cookie
we.howto.1: Open wealthyexile.com in Chrome, Edge or Firefox, and log in.
we.howto.2: Press F12 to open the developer tools, then click the Network tab.
we.howto.3: Press F5 to reload the page.
we.howto.4: Click the first line in the list. It is the page itself.
we.howto.5: Under Request Headers, find the line called Cookie. Right-click it and choose Copy value.
we.howto.6: Paste it in the box below, click Save cookie, then Test.
we.howto.warning: The cookie works like a password for your WealthyExile account: never share it. If WealthyExile logs you out, do this again to paste a fresh one.

ev.title: Game events
ev.hint: The screen plays a full-screen animation when it starts, when the game starts, and on your characters' level-ups and deaths, and when you go back into a map with one portal left. The app only reads the game's log file, Client.txt.
ev.log.missing: Client.txt not found. Start the game once, or enter its path (the logs folder of the game).
ev.anim.hint: Screen start plays when the screen powers on and each time the PC connects to it. Your own GIF, image or video replaces the built-in animation. Test plays the saved choice.
ev.chars.none: None yet: they appear here after their next level-up.
ev.chars.hint: Learned from level-ups. Players seen joining your area are left out. Untick a character to ignore it.
maps.title: Map tracker
maps.hint: Your maps are followed from the same Client.txt: a new map or one more portal, the time spent inside (it pauses after 10 s without keyboard or mouse), deaths and the league mechanics met. The Maps page shows them; the map numbers and the current-map card can also go on any page.
maps.sync.hint: Back in the hideout after a map, the app syncs your stash on WealthyExile, at most once every 5 minutes, so div per map stays up to date without tapping the screen.
idle.title: Idle screen
idle.hint: When the PC has not been used for a while (no keyboard or mouse, and no music or video playing), the screen shows the cat bouncing around. Touch the screen to see the pages for a minute.
idle.enabled: Show the cat when the PC is idle
we.test.unavailable: WealthyExile did not answer as expected (down, or a Cloudflare check). Try again in a few minutes.
we.test.changed: WealthyExile answered, but its page has changed: the app needs an update to read it.
